mem-e573c9db9a11.title: Master AI Workspace & Environment Specification
mem-e573c9db9a11.content: Master AI official root is relocated to F:\Master AI. Environment: Windows 11, Intel Core i5 13th Gen, 32 GB RAM, Python 3.14.5 virtual environment. Docker and WSL2 are disabled by default. Strict fail-closed zero-paid budget enforced.

mem-b7722a64d1dd.title: Phase 1 & Phase 2 Completion Milestones
mem-b7722a64d1dd.content: Phase 1 (Infrastructure) verified with 7/7 smoke tests. Phase 1.1 (Path Correction) created dynamic path_config.py. Phase 2 (Intelligence Layer) delivered Model Registry, Provider Adapters, Router, and Benchmarks with 11/11 tests passing.

mem-518ef04bceb6.title: ADR-001: Centralized Dynamic Path Configuration
mem-518ef04bceb6.content: Context: Relocation from C: to F: broke hardcoded absolute paths. Decision: Implement 00_CORE_SYSTEM/config/path_config.py with dynamic anchor search and MASTER_AI_ROOT override. Forbids hardcoded absolute paths in scripts.

mem-9822c5bc1244.title: ADR-002: Dual-Model Hierarchy and Fail-Closed Security Boundary
mem-9822c5bc1244.content: Context: Prevent unauthorized API charges while enabling agent workflows. Decision: Default to offline-mock-deterministic and local Ollama. Cloud models are strictly gated by SecurityBoundary requiring explicit user approval.

mem-0ccf25b5f0b1.title: ADR-003: Pure-Python BM25 and Embedded Qdrant Vector Storage
mem-0ccf25b5f0b1.content: Context: Windows 11 WDAC blocks untrusted C extensions. Decision: Use pure-Python Okapi BM25 for sparse keyword search combined with embedded Qdrant for dense semantic vectors via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).

mem-c9728be6109c.title: Dynamic Module Import for Leading Digit Directories
mem-c9728be6109c.content: Problem: Python grammar syntax forbids 'import 00_CORE_SYSTEM'. Solution: Use importlib.import_module('00_CORE_SYSTEM.config.path_config') to cleanly load modules with numeric folder prefixes.

mem-5fb22d26faa1.title: Deterministic Offline Mock Embeddings
mem-5fb22d26faa1.content: Problem: Tests must run offline without downloading multi-gigabyte models. Solution: Use SHA-256 token projection with L2 normalization to generate reproducible 128-dim vectors preserving semantic similarity.

mem-f609ea247f52.title: User Operating Preferences and Constraints
mem-f609ea247f52.content: User demands strict zero-hallucination answers with explicit citations. Hindi and English multi-lingual support must be maintained. Nothing goes global without explicit user approval. All test results must be factual.

mem-eb223b90581e.title: Specialist Agent Capabilities & Security Tokens
mem-eb223b90581e.content: Master AI operates 7 specialist agents: software_architect (ADRs, design), coding_agent (implementation), testing_agent (QA, benchmarks), documentation_agent (guides, dashboard), security_auditor (policy gates), capability_discovery_agent (domain tracking), research_agent (deep research).
